INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Audial- Visual Creation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Audial- Visual Creation.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Audial- Visual Creation.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Audial- Visual Creation.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audial- Visual Creation.

2. When learning Robotics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Robotics.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Robotics.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Robotics.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Robotics.

3. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

4. When learning Emerging Trends in ICT, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Emerging Trends in ICT.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Emerging Trends in ICT.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Emerging Trends in ICT.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Emerging Trends in ICT.

5. When learning Digital Citizenship, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Citizenship.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Digital Citizenship.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Citizenship.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Citizenship.

6. When learning Graphic Design, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Graphic Design.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Graphic Design.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Graphic Design.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Graphic Design.

7. When learning Artificial Intelligence, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Artificial Intelligence.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Artificial Intelligence.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Artificial Intelligence.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Artificial Intelligence.

8. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

9. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Keyboard
   C. Speaker
   D. Monitor

10. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Input Cable Tester

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Digital Citizenship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Emerging Trends in ICT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Artificial Intelligence and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Robotics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audial- Visual Creation.

2. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Robotics.

3. B — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

4. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Emerging Trends in ICT.

5. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Citizenship.

6. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Graphic Design.

7. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Artificial Intelligence.

8. D — Never touch live wires with wet hands

9. A — CPU

10. A — Information and Communication Technology

11. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Digital Citizenship; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

12. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Emerging Trends in ICT; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Artificial Intelligence; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Robotics; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
